faq.q: Why use titanium for titanium mmo-coated substrate plate?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti offers the optimal balance of strength, corrosion resistance, and fatigue life for titanium mmo-coated substrate plate.

faq.q: How is a titanium mmo-coated substrate plate manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium mmo-coated substrate plate is manufactured using Powder sintering; CNC machining; Sheet fabrication; TIG welding. Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 2 CP-Ti for titanium mmo-coated substrate plate?
faq.a: Stainless steel (corrosion risk), carbon steel (rapid rusting), plastic (low strength)

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium mmo-coated substrate plate?
faq.a: Titanium MMO-Coated Substrate Plate components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply depending on the application and regulatory requirements.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium mmo-coated substrate plate?
faq.a: With proper material selection (Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V) and manufacturing process control (thread rolling, heat treatment), titanium titanium mmo-coated substrate plate components exhibit excellent fatigue life and corrosion resistance in service.

faq.q: What surface treatments are available for titanium mmo-coated substrate plate?
faq.a: Common surface treatments include Passivation ASTM F86. These enhance corrosion resistance, wear properties, and aesthetic appearance.
